cause.summary: Distributed crawler bursts saturated dynamic product and image routes while product OpenGraph generation downloaded and decoded unbounded remote images.
evidence: Nginx recorded bursts of upstream prematurely closed connection responses for product OpenGraph images.
The previous web container recorded ImageResponse memory access out of bounds failures.
The active and standby containers had not restarted and were not OOM-killed.

mitigations: Grouped AhrefsBot, Amzn-SearchBot, facebookexternalhit and meta-webindexer into global crawler rate-limit keys.
Expanded the grouped hosting-provider network ranges observed in the incident.
Removed remote product-image download and base64 decoding from product OpenGraph generation.
Replaced the dynamic-font approximation glyph with an ASCII marker.
Pruned 18.98 GB of disposable Docker build cache without deleting running containers, databases or rollback images.

validation.postSwitch: No new 5xx, upstream disconnect, ImageResponse memory error or dynamic-font error observed during acceptance window.
